notes: This documents the top-of-line WATCHPAX 62 Model C configuration (full I/O superset), per Dataton's official cutsheet (Doc 3769 Rev 6.1) and User's Guide v3.5. The series also ships as: Model S (base — only 4x DisplayPort 1.4 out + 4x USB-A + 2x 10GbE, no HDMI/SDI/audio/sync connectors); Model A (adds the 2x HDMI 1.4 capture inputs + DB-26HD/XLR audio-timecode breakout); Model B (adds Frame-Lock RJ45 sync ports + External Sync BNC for hardware GPU synchronization, same I/O as Model A plus these); Model C (adds the 8-channel bidirectional Micro-BNC SDI bank + dedicated SDI Sync BNC on top of Model B's I/O). All models share the IEC C14 power inlet, 4x USB-A, and 2x 10GbE (2nd port disabled/reserved on all models). Weight varies by model: S/A ~8.3kg, B ~8.6kg, C ~8.8kg; unit dimensions 446x88x336mm (2U) across the series. USB port-to-speed (2.0 vs 3.2) mapping is not specified by Dataton at the individual-port level. The DB-26HD "AUDIO" D-sub jack (not in the standard connector-id list) is represented here as 3 separate XLR-style ports matching the labels on Dataton's supplied breakout cable, since that is the practical cabling interface. SDI jacks are Micro BNC (HD-BNC) format requiring the bundled adapter cables to mate with standard BNC — represented with connector id "bnc" as the closest match.

ports.name: USB 1
ports.note: Cutsheet states 2x USB 2.0 + 2x USB 3.2 across the 4 USB-A ports; exact port-to-speed mapping and USB 3.2 generation not specified by Dataton, so no per-port grade assigned.

ports.name: USB 2
ports.note: See USB 1 note on unspecified 2.0/3.2 mapping.

ports.name: USB 3
ports.note: See USB 1 note on unspecified 2.0/3.2 mapping.

ports.name: USB 4
ports.note: See USB 1 note on unspecified 2.0/3.2 mapping.

ports.name: LAN 2
ports.note: Present on chassis but currently disabled in firmware; reserved for future use per Dataton documentation.

ports.name: Audio Out 1 (XLR breakout)
ports.note: Chassis jack is physically a DB-26HD D-sub labeled 'AUDIO'; breaks out via Dataton-supplied cable into XLR leads. This is the 'Left Out' lead (balanced analog audio ch.1, or digital embedded audio). Models A/B/C only.

ports.name: Audio Out 2 (XLR breakout)
ports.note: Same DB-26HD breakout jack as Audio Out 1; 'Right Out' lead (audio ch.2). Models A/B/C only.

ports.name: Timecode In (XLR breakout)
ports.note: Same DB-26HD breakout jack; 'Left In' lead is wired for SMPTE LTC timecode input (the 'Right In' lead is reserved/unused). Models A/B/C only.

ports.name: HDMI 1 (Capture In)
ports.note: Labeled 'Capture card HDMI-1 (RX1)' in Dataton's connector table; capture bandwidth spec confirmed as HDMI 1.4-class (max 297 Mpixel/s, up to 4096x2160p30). Models A/B/C only.

ports.name: HDMI 2 (Capture In)
ports.note: Labeled 'Capture card HDMI-2 (RX0)' in Dataton's connector table. Models A/B/C only.

ports.name: Frame-Lock 1
ports.note: Proprietary hardware frame-lock sync between WATCHPAX units over Cat5 cable — NOT standard Ethernet data. Dataton explicitly warns not to connect to a network switch/NIC. Models B/C only.

ports.name: Frame-Lock 2
ports.note: Second Frame-Lock port, same function as Frame-Lock 1. Models B/C only.

ports.name: External Sync
ports.note: Genlock/sync-generator reference input for the GPU hardware synchronization card (bi- or tri-level sync). Models B/C only.

ports.name: SDI 1
ports.note: Physical jack is Micro BNC (HD-BNC), not full-size BNC; Dataton ships 9x Micro BNC-to-BNC adapter cables. Channel 1 supports up to 12G/6G-SDI. Configurable per-channel as input or output. Model C only.

ports.name: SDI 2
ports.note: Micro BNC (HD-BNC) jack; 3G-SDI max on this channel. Model C only.

ports.name: SDI 3
ports.note: Micro BNC (HD-BNC) jack; 3G-SDI max on this channel. Model C only.

ports.name: SDI 4
ports.note: Micro BNC (HD-BNC) jack; 3G-SDI max on this channel. Model C only.

ports.name: SDI 5
ports.note: Micro BNC (HD-BNC) jack; supports up to 12G/6G-SDI (the second of two 12G-capable channels). Model C only.

ports.name: SDI 6
ports.note: Micro BNC (HD-BNC) jack; 3G-SDI max on this channel. Model C only.

ports.name: SDI 7
ports.note: Micro BNC (HD-BNC) jack; 3G-SDI max on this channel. Model C only.

ports.name: SDI 8
ports.note: Micro BNC (HD-BNC) jack; 3G-SDI max on this channel. Model C only.

ports.name: SDI Sync
ports.note: Dedicated tri-level/bi-level sync reference input for the SDI board (labeled 'S' in the SDI connector bank), distinct from the main External Sync BNC. Model C only.
